comparisons.comparison: Both AVGO and AMD define the minimum exercise price for stock options granted under their respective equity plans as being no less than the fair market value of the common stock on the date of grant. AVGO's 2007 Plan mandates an exercise price 'no less than the fair market value,' while AMD's 2023 Plan specifies that the exercise price 'cannot be less than 100% of the fair market value.' Both disclosures confirm the grant of both nonstatutory and incentive stock options (AMD explicitly names them; AVGO names stock options generally within the 2007 Plan context which it aligns with the 2012 Plan terms).
